raw_response: {"diagnosis": "From batch 3 onward the source delivers many POSTED transactions up to about 3 days after txn_ts. The silver filter `ingest_ts - txn_ts <= 26 hours` silently drops these valid, unique transactions. Batches 1 and 2 had no late rows, so they raised no alerts. Every txn_id is distinct and the gold tables are fully recomputed, so including late arrivals is safe.", "decision": "fix", "confidence": 0.72, "pre_sql": [], "step_overrides": {"silver_transactions": "CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE silver_transactions AS SELECT CAST(txn_id AS BIGINT) AS txn_id, customer_id, CAST(merchant_id AS INTEGER) AS merchant_id, CAST(amount AS DECIMAL(12,2)) AS amount, CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) AS txn_ts, CAST(CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) AS DATE) AS txn_date FROM raw_transactions WHERE status = 'POSTED'"}}
